# tebib_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project by ID or by name. With neither, it reads the provider's `project`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebib_project" "current" {}

data "tebib_project" "staging" {
  name = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `name` (String) Project name (looked up in the organization).
- `organization_id` (String) Organization to search by name. Default: the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags.
- `trn` (String) The project's TRN.
